m: Take the steaks out of the fridge 20 minutes before cooking, pat dry and season generously with salt.
Cut the potatoes into 2cm cubes and boil 6 minutes until just tender. Drain and let them steam dry for 2 minutes.

Salsa verde: finely chop the parsley, mint, capers and garlic. Mix with the lemon zest and juice, about 3 tablespoons of olive oil for every 2 serves and a pinch of salt. It should be loose and punchy.
Fry the potatoes in a good splash of oil over medium-high heat for 10 to 12 minutes, turning, until golden and crisp. Keep warm in a low oven.
Get a heavy pan smoking hot. Cook the steaks 3 to 4 minutes a side for medium-rare (55°C inside), adding the butter for the last minute and spooning it over. Rest for 5 minutes. Don't skip the rest.

While the steak rests, char the asparagus in the steak pan for 3 minutes. Slice the steak against the grain and serve with the potatoes and asparagus, salsa verde spooned over and the resting juices poured on top.
l: Slice the steak and pack it cold with the potatoes and asparagus, salsa verde in a separate container. Best eaten cold or at room temperature, not microwaved.
g: Naturally gluten free. Nothing to swap.
